rules.xfer_works: called("transfer") and reverted and (arg(1) <= pre("balanceOf", sender))
rules.auth_mint: ok and sender != pre("owner") and post("totalSupply") > pre("totalSupply")
rules.mint_supply: called("mint") and ok and post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + arg(1)
rules.mint_to: called("mint") and ok and post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1)
rules.xfer_from: called("transfer") and ok and arg(0) != sender and post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(1) != pre("balanceOf", sender)
rules.xfer_to: called("transfer") and ok and arg(0) != sender and post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1)
